changes.comment: feat: removed extend(), isRegistered(), isNamespaceRegistered(), Formatter.clear(), and the pipe-plural shorthand. has() is leaf-only by default (use { kind: 'branch' }). isLoaded()/isNamespaceLoaded() now throw on invalid locale tags. getSupportedLocales() takes { sorted }. I18nState is versioned. loadNamespace(ns, factory?, locale?) now does register+load in one call.

feat: createTranslator() — minimal static single-locale factory (t/ti/tp/tpi) for per-component catalogs, and ti()/tpi() segmented interpolation (mixed Array<string|V>, plus a raw-number count segment for tpi()) on Translator, I18n, and ScopedI18n
feat!: redesign localization around explicit catalogs and declarative resources
